Downloaded 2026-09-28 from the upstream repositories.

settings.svg: Lucide, ISC license
https://github.com/lucide-icons/lucide/blob/main/icons/settings.svg
License: Lucide-LICENSE.txt (also includes Feather attribution for inherited icons).
UiIcon.cs combines the path and circle, using the app's existing 1.7 px outline.

github.svg: GitHub Octicons mark-github-16, MIT license
https://github.com/primer/octicons/blob/main/icons/mark-github-16.svg
License: Octicons-LICENSE.txt.
UiIcon.cs uses the original filled path with a 16-unit view box.

Both geometries are parsed once and drawn locally. No icon library or network request is required at runtime.
